answer: The dye master re-tenters the shrunken web on the tenter frame to square it, pinning the web square before it dries, and the work is the stronger for it. Tenter thread stocking knitter silk bond is what makes the re-tentering hold: a bond thread stocking knitters lodge after knitting hearth trials. The vine takes up the re-tentering, the cipher finishes the frame, the beacon signs the web. To fake it costs 181 false webs and 181 false re-tenterings.
